summary: Keep malformed named-source TEXT fingerprint decoding from suppressing valid peer wake hints.

replay.detail: No admission, replay, source capture, prepared publication or retained-root certification is supplied or changed.

schema.detail: No schema, index, trigger, journal or persisted counter is created. Explicit attachment reads existing Installer metadata.

rules.detail: No authority, retention, checkpoint, digest or read-coverage rules change.

compatibility.detail: Opt-in named-source capture compares bounded raw SQLite TEXT bytes to the configured fingerprint before any UTF-8 String decoding. Malformed source values produce individual invalidation while valid peers retain raw progress. Public methods, SQL statement count and default Publisher behavior are unchanged. No production source activation is included.

downtime.detail: Library-only source change; no deployment or restart behavior is implemented.

manual.detail: Adopting source owners retain native capture, full-cut checks and explicit replacement/restore lifetime guards. Identical metadata DDL and root pages cannot certify table incarnation. No production adopter or recovery procedure is installed.

recovery.detail: Configured identities remain fixed. A logical mismatch does not rebind authority or suppress peer raw-progress wakes; common schema/storage failure still invalidates the full scope. Initial state is not broadcast, so subscribers must independently check coverage. Source-owned lifetime/replacement/restore guards remain required and no wake restores Ready.
